svg.aria-label: Hey, I'm Chris. Applied math and CS student at UW-Stout. From my Real Analysis portfolio: a function that is continuous everywhere and differentiable nowhere, f(x) = sum of (3/4)^n K(4^n x), drawn as its partial sums for n = 0 to 5.
